issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify a method Lecture.addGuestStudents(int, String): void (adds guest students with a reason), but the solution implements addGuestStudents(int) with only one parameter. This signature mismatch prevents students from matching their implementation to the specification and would fail tests expecting the two-parameter method.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution method signature to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) to match the specification/UML. The reason parameter can be accepted but unused if no further behavior is required, or incorporate it (e.g., logging) if intended.
